content: The aim of this work was twofold: to design a discursive segmenter using a minimum of resources and to establish an evaluation protocol to measure the performance of segmenters. The results show that we can build a simple version of the baseline, which employs only a list of markers and presents a very encouraging performance. Of course, the quality of the list is a preponderant factor for a correct segmentation.
